value.basis: WAIS-style backward span in young adults averages about 5 digits with SD ~1.2; the lenient 'longest length with at least one correct trial' criterion, visual presentation at a slowish 1.2 s rate, typed (self-paced) recall, and a well-educated 18–35 Norwegian sample push the mean up roughly half a digit, while unproctored online testing adds a little variance.
